{{nihongo|'''Niwa Shrine'''|爾波神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

Its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

It is the “Niwa Shrine” of {{ill|Niwa District|Q1347719|qid=Q1347719}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}}. It is said to have been the sōsha of Niwa District, and has deep ties to the {{ill|Niwa clan|de|Niwa (Klan)|fa|خاندان نیوا|fr|Clan Niwa|it|Clan Niwa|ja|丹羽氏|nl|Niwa (clan)|qid=Q2661652|lt=Niwa no Omi}}.

It is said to have begun when the Owari Niwa no Omi, who held influence in this area, enshrined their ancestor Kamuyaimimi-no-Mikoto.
* Its original name was Niwa Shrine. From the {{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}} onward, it was called “Niwa Tenjin,” “Niwa Ōkami,” or “Niwa Tenjin.”

They were rebuilt, but in {{ill|1666|ab|1666|af|1666|als|1666|am|1666 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1666|ar|1666|ary|1666|arz|1666|ast|1666|avk|1666|az|1666|azb|۱۶۶۶ (میلادی)|ban|1666|bcl|1666|be|1666|be_x_old|1666|bg|1666|bn|১৬৬৬|bpy|মারি ১৬৬৬|br|1666|bs|1666.|ca|1666|cdo|1666 nièng|ceb|1666|ckb|١٦٦٦|crh|1666|cs|1666|cv|1666|cy|1666|da|1666|de|1666|diq|1666|el|1666|eml|1666|eo|1666|es|1666|et|1666|eu|1666|fa|۱۶۶۶ (میلادی)|fi|1666|fo|1666|fr|1666|frp|1666|frr|1666|fur|1666|fy|1666|ga|1666|gan|1666年|gcr|1666|gd|1666|gl|1666|gv|1666|he|1666|hi|१६६६|hif|1666|hr|1666.|hsb|1666|ht|1666 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1666|hy|1666|hyw|1666 թուական|ia|1666|id|1666|ilo|1666|io|1666|is|1666|it|1666|ja|1666年|jv|1666|ka|1666|kaa|1666|kk|1666 жыл|ko|1666년|krc|1666 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1666|la|1666|lb|1666|lij|1666|lmo|1666|lt|1666 m.|lv|1666. gads|mai|१६६६|map_bms|1666|mdf|1666|mhr|1666|mi|1666|mk|1666|mr|इ.स. १६६६|mrj|1666 и|ms|1666|my|၁၆၆၆|myv|1666 ие|mzn|۱۶۶۶|nah|1666|nap|1666|nds|1666|new|सन् १६६६|nl|1666|nn|1666|no|1666|nrm|1666|nso|1666|oc|1666|olo|1666|or|୧୬୬୬|os|1666-æм аз|pa|1666|pl|1666|pnb|1666|pt|1666|qu|1666|ro|1666|ru|1666 год|rue|1666|sa|१६६६|sah|1666|scn|1666|sd|1666ع|se|1666|sh|1666.|shn|1666|simple|1666|sk|1666|sl|1666|smn|1666|sq|1666|sr|1666|stq|1666|su|1666|sv|1666|sw|1666|szl|1666|ta|1666|te|1666|tg|Соли 1666|th|พ.ศ. 2209|tk|1666|tl|1666|tly|1666|tr|1666|tt|1666 ел|uk|1666|ur|1666ء|uz|1666|vec|1666|vi|1666|vls|1666|wa|1666|war|1666|wuu|1666年|xmf|1666|yi|1666|zea|1666|zh|1666年|zh_classical|一六六六年|zh_min_nan|1666 nî|zh_yue|1666年|qid=Q7585}} ({{ill|Kanbun (era)|Q1146228|qid=Q1146228}} 6) they were damaged by flood. The shrine was moved to its current site. At that time, it was rebuilt in the precincts of a {{ill|Rinzai school|Q639625|qid=Q639625}} temple (Keijizan Tōkō-ji) and renamed Myōjin-sha.
* In {{ill|1870|Q7741|qid=Q7741}} (Meiji 3), it was renamed Niwa Shrine, and in {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5), it became a gōsha.
* On July 28, {{ill|1945|Q5240|qid=Q5240}} (Shōwa 20), all shrine buildings were destroyed in an air raid ({{ill|Bombing of Ichinomiya|Q48744775|qid=Q48744775}}) during the {{ill|Pacific War|Q184425|qid=Q184425}}. The current buildings were rebuilt in {{ill|1948|Q5165|qid=Q5165}} (Shōwa 23).

=== Access ===
* {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397}}: get off at “Niwa” bus stop, 10 minutes on foot
** From {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|Q2856589|qid=Q2856589}} on the {{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|Q1137838|qid=Q1137838}}/{{ill|Meitetsu Bisai Line|Q901005|qid=Q901005}} of {{ill|Meitetsu|Q30850|qid=Q30850}}, or from {{ill|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|Q871495|qid=Q871495}} on the {{ill|Tōkaidō Main Line|Q1190152|qid=Q1190152}} (Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station bus terminal, platform 3), take a bus bound for “Miyata Hongō (via Niwa).”
